title: Publish private monorepo and delivery project
acceptance: Verify repository and project are private.
No collaborators added; inspect inherited organization access.
Publish specifications and link issues, milestones and timeline.

title: Decompose baseline and competitor scope into acceptance criteria
acceptance: Every Dolibarr public feature has an ID.
Record competitor editions, sources and gaps without claiming exhaustive parity.
Identify native/integration decisions and web/Android/iPhone checks.

title: Define module boundaries and financial transaction model
acceptance: Document module ownership and interfaces.
Model invoice/payment/revenue separately.
Define tenant identity and journal invariants.

title: Prove reproducible Java build and module boundary checks
acceptance: Select supported Java/Spring versions with sources.
Clean build and automated boundary test run.
Record database-per-customer feasibility questions.

title: Review pilot scenarios with accountant HR manager and tax auditor
acceptance: Review synthetic accounting/payroll cases.
Document current rules needing authoritative validation.
Agree pilot acceptance owners and weekly review cadence.

title: Re-estimate roadmap after six weeks at 20 hours per week
acceptance: Compare actual hours and accepted scope with baseline.
Forecast remaining work and quantify unresolved scope.
Update dates transparently without silently reducing scope.

title: Tenant provisioning branches roles audit and module activation
acceptance: Provision tenant and branches; isolate API/files/jobs.
Enforce roles, MFA/session controls and activation dependencies.

title: CRM quotations orders contracts and subscriptions
acceptance: Complete lead-to-order and contract renewal workflows.
Version terms and prevent duplicate scheduled billing.

title: Ledger invoicing payments bank imports and financial statements
acceptance: Balanced idempotent postings; period close/reversal controls.
Reconcile invoices payments bank imports and statements with accountant.

title: Employee records attendance leave and delegated approvals
acceptance: Portal clock events timesheets and device imports.
Overtime only from authorized approvals; effective-dated delegation.

title: Nigeria payroll contractor payments and private payslips
acceptance: Validate salary allowances commissions overtime pension PAYE loans.
Separate contractor treatment; HR/accountant/tax sign-off.
Own-record payslip access from first run and at least 12 months when accumulated.

title: Demonstrate selected complete workflows on synthetic data
acceptance: Selected sale-to-ledger and employee/payroll flows demonstrated.
Document missing behavior; do not claim full suite readiness.

title: Purchasing inventory shipment returns and valuation
acceptance: Reconcile stock movements reservations transfers and counts.
Trace serial/batch items and reconcile valuation to ledger.

title: Multi-currency assets budgets dimensions and job costing
acceptance: Validate realized/unrealized FX and depreciation.
Budget/actual branch cost-centre project and phase/cost-code reports.

title: Projects interventions timesheets expenses and delivery billing
acceptance: Trace project work expenses costs milestones and invoices.
Support generic services and optional training workflows.

title: Customer-owned and managed email WhatsApp SMS connectors
acceptance: Store scoped credentials securely; support tenant-specific accounts.
Retry safely and expose pending/failed delivery and usage.

title: Android and iPhone coverage for all ERP functions
acceptance: Every functional requirement has mobile evidence.
SaaS only; secure sessions files administrative flows and store distribution.
Deliver alongside modules; final date is parity gate, not mobile start date.

title: Recruitment onboarding appraisals learning benefits offboarding
acceptance: End-to-end employee lifecycle and restricted self-service.
Version entitlements and validate permissions.

title: Helpdesk knowledge memberships agenda and productivity
acceptance: Ticket assignment/escalation and contract entitlements.
Membership renewals calendar reminders and knowledge visibility.

title: Website CMS POS marketing surveys and appointments
acceptance: Publish content and run POS session sale/return/reconciliation.
Consent-aware campaigns surveys bookings and reminders.
Define local-server outage behavior without assuming device sync.

title: Manufacturing quality maintenance rental and barcode workflows
acceptance: BOM consumption output costing and traceability.
Inspection/corrective actions equipment maintenance and rental returns.
Scan supported product/location operations.

title: Custom records forms workflows reports automation and signatures
acceptance: Version and permission custom definitions safely.
No arbitrary tenant code in shared SaaS.
Trace approvals signatures events and integration operations.

title: Revenue recognition close management and advanced reporting
acceptance: Deferred schedules reconcile to earned revenue and ledger.
Close tasks exceptions audit evidence and controlled reopening.
Document multi-entity benchmark conflict with one-entity product model.

title: Validated Excel Dolibarr Zoho Odoo Sage and Peachtree migration
acceptance: Excel first; adapter versions and supported entities explicit.
Preview map deduplicate reconcile and trial cutover.
Distinguish balances/open items from full historical migration.

title: SaaS dedicated and on-premises operations recovery and upgrades
acceptance: Separate staging; repeatable deployment and upgrade/rollback.
Restore rehearsal and external encrypted backups.
Validate office intranet workflow and external queues.

title: Validate 50 tenants and 250 concurrent users
acceptance: Representative active workload and measured p95 latency.
Capacity, isolation, financial integrity and resource usage recorded.
Recovery objectives verified or revised with evidence.
First SaaS deployment/recovery slice of OPS-001 available before testing; full OPS epic may finish later.

title: Close competitor register and full-scope acceptance
acceptance: Enumerate and resolve every approved competitor gap.
Track standalone Zoho tools/vendor AI/native vs integration decisions.
Specialist acceptance and web/Android/iPhone coverage complete.
